changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate dataset name and normalized model names to canonical forms (removed specific version numbers since they refer to the same base models). Consolidated and improved output descriptions.
Removed duplicate metric and normalized to consistent capitalization. Both metrics (accuracy and distractor selection frequency) are explicitly used to evaluate generated reasoning outputs.
Cleared all fields as the paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators. LLMs are only used as reasoning models, not for evaluation.
Cleared all fields as the paper explicitly states it does not conduct human experiments. Only automatic evaluation is performed.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on analyzing LLM reasoning strategies (heuristic vs rational) in multi-step arithmetic tasks, not traditional NLG evaluation. The NLG aspects are limited to step-by-step reasoning generation as a means to study reasoning behavior. Automatic evaluation uses accuracy and distractor selection frequencies to measure reasoning quality.
